title: micranthus spicatus
intro: Micranthus spicatus, commonly known as the 'Bridal Bouquet' or 'Wedding Bouquet', is a flowering plant species in the family Iridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
